recentItems.title: Sara Bareilles on why she hands out tissues at concerts: "It won't fix anything, but..."
recentItems.description: Handing out tissues at a concert isn't about fixing anything, it's permission to feel it. Sometimes bearing witness is the whole point. Sara Bareilles gets real about grief, "Good Grief," and what it actually means to be there for someone in a hard place. #shorts

recentItems.title: Sara Bareilles on grief: "You don't dissolve into it, you survive it"
recentItems.description: "You don't dissolve into the big feelings, you actually survive them." 🤍 #SaraBareillesOnElvis ⁣

recentItems.title: Sara Bareilles on grief: "20 minutes later I'm dancing in the rain on my back lawn"
recentItems.description: "There's no right or wrong way to grieve someone."Grief doesn't follow a schedule and it doesn't look one way for everybody. #SaraBareillesOnElvis ⁣

recentItems.title: Sara Bareilles on the self-talk that keeps her going: "I promise you, you're enough"
recentItems.description: Sara Bareilles on the mirror talk she gives herself every night... "I promise you, you're enough." 🥹#SaraBareillesOnElvis ⁣

recentItems.description:
We debate the weirdest thing you’ve ever seen at a wedding, share unpopular opinions, and find out whether you’re a city or country person. Plus, we talk about unfollowing people, helping a parent, quality time vs. alone time, living a double life, how old you were when you knew what you wanted to be, and Gandhi and Froggy go dumpster diving!
